column1: # Source: Vercel AI Gateway Production Index
# Locator: October 2026 report section 'Open-weight share of tokens and spend' (monthly percentage series
# License: Factual-Extract (published monthly open-weight token and spend shares from Vercel AI Gateway Production Index
# Epistemic: measured (gateway-reported monthly share of total production token volume and total inference spend served by open-weight models from December 2025 through September 2026)
# Method: scripted (extracted monthly open-weight token-volume and spend share percentages from the published October 2026 gateway report)
# Computation: Extracted monthly percentage series (2025-12 through 2026-09) directly from the published October 2026 gateway report.
#   month: string [YYYY-MM] — Calendar month of aggregated Vercel AI Gateway production traffic
#   token_share_pct: number [percent] — Share of total monthly production token volume served by open-weight models
#   spend_share_pct: number [percent] — Share of total monthly inference dollar spend accounted for by open-weight models
# Notes: Closed-weight share is the complement (100 minus open-weight share) on the same multi-provider gateway.
